content.text: {"claim_true":false,"claim_reason":"The displayed family has infinitely many distinct inclusion-minimal finite transversals, so it disproves the universal claim.","witness_valid":true,"witness_reason":"Each F_n is finite and nonempty, and all share x_1. Each T_k meets F_n via y_n for n<k and x_k for n>=k. Removing y_i makes it miss F_i; removing x_k makes it miss F_k. Thus every T_k is minimal, and they are distinct."}
